leadText:
The Hi-Hat Café (Japanese: ハイハットカフェ Hi-Hat Café) is a café owned by Pablo Millan in Ryme City in the game and its sequel Detective Pikachu Returns. It is known for its coffee and live music.

In the original games, it is located on the first floor of a building south of Tahnti Park, below the Baker Detective Agency. It is first visited at the end of Chapter 2. In the sequel, the café has moved to its own separate building west of . It is noticeably larger, and has a proper stage for performing musicians. It is open from 10 am to 10 pm and is closed on Mondays .
